en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small mountain village with an alpine backdrop. Prominently featured are a tall, narrow church bell tower with a clock and adjoining church, as well as the adjacent municipal building. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Pejo's town hall and church at an altitude of 1580 meters. There is some handwritten cursive text on the front. The card has a simple cream border and printed publisher information along the bottom edge.
